collections.title: Tari Cases
collections.descriptionHtml: Hand-tooled leather tari cases built on a fibreglass shell, lined in velvet and finished with a combination lock. Made to order in Los Baños, Laguna.

collections.title: Catch Bags
collections.descriptionHtml: Hand-sewn leather catch bags that protect your catch cock from the blows of your game fowl during sparring and training.

collections.title: Takera & Accessories
collections.descriptionHtml: Leather takera, tari sheaths, sharpener cases and arm protectors: the small pieces every sabungero carries.

collections.title: Custom Builds
collections.descriptionHtml: Made-to-order tari cases, hand-tooled with your gamefarm name, logo or crest. Each piece pictured was built for a client; yours is made from scratch to your design. Price depends on capacity.

products.title: Leather Tari Case — Basket Weave
products.descriptionHtml:
Our signature tari case, hand-tooled with a basket-weave pattern and floral border on genuine leather. A rigid fibreglass shell keeps its shape, and the red velvet interior holds your tari, sheaths and tools in individual compartments.

  • Genuine leather, hand-stamped design
  • Fibreglass shell, velvet-lined compartments
  • Custom leather handle
  • Combination lock
  • 24-blade capacity

Each case is made to order. Contact us to add your gamefarm name or logo.

products.title: Leather Tari Case — Crocodile Embossed
products.descriptionHtml:
A deep brown crocodile-embossed leather case on an all-fibreglass body. Inside, a lift-out tray and padded blade pockets keep everything in place, lined in red velvet.

  • Crocodile-embossed genuine leather
  • All-fibreglass shell
  • Velvet-lined tray and blade pockets
  • Padded leather handle, chrome latches
  • 24-blade capacity

products.title: Leather Tari Case — Square with Shoulder Strap
products.descriptionHtml:
A compact, square tari case with a hand-tooled lid personalised with your gamefarm name, and a detachable leather shoulder strap for carrying hands-free into the derby.

  • Hand-tooled and personalised genuine leather
  • Velvet-lined compartments
  • Detachable, adjustable leather shoulder strap
  • Chrome latches
  • 24-blade capacity

Pictured: a custom build for Lanjean Gamefarm. Send us your name or logo to make it yours.

products.title: Leather Catch Bag
products.descriptionHtml:
A hand-sewn leather catch bag (body protector) that shields your catch cock from the blows of your game fowl during sparring and gaff testing. A sturdy top handle and buckle strap keep the bird secure and easy to hold.

  • ~3mm genuine leather
  • Hand-stitched with 1mm nylon thread
  • Top carry handle with buckle closure
  • Stamped with the RGB LeatherCrafts mark

products.title: Leather Catch Bag — Foam Padded
products.descriptionHtml:
Our catch bag with an added foam-padded leather lining for extra protection and comfort for the bird. The padded insert is removable for cleaning.

  • Genuine leather outer, hand-stitched
  • Removable foam-padded leather lining
  • Top carry handle with buckle closure

products.title: Leather Takera
products.descriptionHtml:
A pocket-sized, hand-tooled leather takera that holds your tari blades in individual sleeves, so they stay sharp and organised at the derby. Closes with a leather strap and buckle.

  • Genuine leather, hand-tooled side panels
  • Individual blade sleeves
  • Strap and buckle closure

products.title: Leather Tari Sheath
products.descriptionHtml:
A curved, hand-stitched leather sheath shaped to fit over the tari blade, protecting both the edge and your hands when it is not in use.

  • Genuine leather, hand-stitched
  • Curved to the shape of the blade
  • Sold individually

products.title: Leather Sharpener Case
products.descriptionHtml:
A hand-tooled leather case for your blade sharpening stone, with a floral carved design. Keeps the stone clean and your takera tidy.

  • Genuine leather, hand-tooled floral design
  • Fits a standard flat sharpening stone

products.title: Leather Arm Protector
products.descriptionHtml:
A stitched leather arm guard with double buckle straps that protects the handler's forearm from spurs and gaffs while sparring.

  • Genuine leather, hand-stitched
  • Two adjustable buckle straps

products.title: Custom 6-Capacity Tari Case — Floral Name Tooling
products.descriptionHtml:
A compact 6-capacity case, small enough to carry anywhere, with your name carved into a deep floral pattern across the lid and sides.

Pictured: a past custom build. Every case is made to order, so we'll tool your own name, logo or design. Message us with your idea before ordering and we'll confirm the design and lead time.
